final: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN 1.0 * ili.product_price / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_per_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_invoice_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item
